title: Foundation for Payables Agent V2.0
summary: Lays the foundation for Payables Agent v2.0, a rewrite in which the agent works directly on purchase invoices instead of the draft page and E-Document pipeline. V2 is not activated yet and v1 compatibility stays in place, though v1 KPIs now count finalized Purchase Invoices and role center cues no longer count E-Documents.
key_points: Rewrites the Payables Agent app under new organizing principles described in architecture.md
Keeps v1 working through a draft-based compatibility layer; v2 activation is deferred until validation is done
KPI tracking now counts finalized Purchase Invoices instead of E-Documents, so it applies to both versions
Role center activity cues no longer count E-Documents
Lists known v2 gaps: email sourcing, credit memos, feedback UI, billing model and accuracy parity
quote: V1 compatibility is in place, so end-users won't feel this change, and we can activate when ready.
